## Technical Expertise
- **Mobile Engineering**: Flutter, Dart, Android SDK, Java, Kotlin, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) packet telemetry, Android Accessibility Service.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Socket.IO WebSockets, BullMQ background queues, Redis caching, Render deployment.
- **Databases & ORM**: PostgreSQL, CockroachDB (distributed ACID transactions), MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, Supabase, MySQL, SQLite, Prisma ORM.
- **Frontend & Web**: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Electron, Technical SEO & Web Performance, Schema.org Structured Data.
- **Developer Tooling & Languages**: Python, C++, C, PHP, Git, GitHub, VS Code, CLion, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Gradle, Godot.

## Flagship Engineering Ecosystems & Projects
1. **Caredify (Startup PFE Graduation Ecosystem)**: Remote cardiac ECG telemetry platform. Mobile app built in Flutter streaming continuous biometric waveform data over BLE to a Node.js/MongoDB Atlas cloud backend with AI arrhythmia anomaly detection.
2. **Football Manager Multiplayer Game**: Real-time multiplayer tactical football ecosystem. NestJS and Socket.IO match state engine with CockroachDB distributed transactions, Prisma ORM, Redis session caching, and BullMQ auction expiration timers deployed on Render with a Flutter mobile client.
3. **KabaadHub Commercial Marketplace**: Production scrap recycling marketplace published on the Google Play Store (Flutter & Firebase) with in-app chat, geolocation filtering, and a Flutter Web admin moderation portal.
4. **Mkarchi Tooling Ecosystem**: Open-source developer project scaffolding engine published on PyPI (Python CLI), companion Electron desktop workspace, and Next.js documentation portal.
5. **QuizApp Arena**: Real-time multiplayer trivia ecosystem with sub-second synchronized timers, Flutter mobile app, Node.js Socket.IO backend, Supabase persistence, and Flutter Web dashboard.
6. **Anti-Scroll**: Android digital wellbeing application built with Java and native Android Accessibility Services.
